explication: Vector is an observability data pipeline for collecting, transforming, enriching, buffering, routing, and delivering logs and metrics. The principal workflow is operator configuration through topology construction, source ingestion and decoding, event processing, then buffered sink delivery to external services. Sampled code confirms topology reload and shutdown, tap interception, codecs, enrichment-related infrastructure, adaptive sink concurrency, GCS encoding, and metric storage. Many individual source and sink implementations were not sampled, so those relationships are intentionally represented at subsystem level.
